Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; Woodpecker has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Woodpecker has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner (the runner label linux has no Woodpecker form; only labels.platform does)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.manual: manual or deployment event (the source runs on these events and its file has no trigger form for them; Woodpecker starts each as its nearest event: api as manual, trigger as manual)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
